comment: Pre-registered mechanical expectations for the program ledger. Each entry names a claim and a computation the evaluator (tools/evaluate.py) must reproduce exactly from the stated inputs. Expectations are data: adding one never changes evaluator code. A claim with no expectation here is checked for consistency only, and a claim stating a percentage without in-ledger inputs is reported NOT_DERIVABLE rather than passed over in silence.

expectations.label: pooled probe cost per resolved task fell about 32 percent
closed spend + spendable remaining + untouched reserve = program cap
